name: Ball State University
academic_ranking: Public R2 doctoral research university (High research activity). ~20,440 students (14,874 undergrad, fall 2023). 2024 acceptance rate ~68.9%; avg enrolled HS GPA 3.52; test-optional (submitters avg ~1180 SAT / 25 ACT). ~120 undergraduate majors across ten colleges; 16:1 student-faculty ratio. U.S. News (2021) ~#213 national universities; noted for social mobility and online master's programs.
financial_aid: Public university with separate in-state (~$8,284/yr) and out-of-state (~$25,518/yr) undergraduate tuition (2021-22 figures per Wikipedia; verify current year with ballstate.edu). NCAA D1 athletic scholarships available for softball; institutional need- and merit-based aid also offered. Exact softball scholarship allocations not publicly listed.
facilities_notes: Team plays at the Ball State softball stadium on the Muncie campus (referenced on official roster/news pages; e.g., a walk-off victory over Kent State at the Ball State softball stadium). Detailed capacity/feature specs not published on the softball pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: Established NCAA D1 program in the Mid-American Conference. Historic highlight: two Women's College World Series appearances (1973 and 1975, per Wikipedia). Competes annually in MAC softball.
notes: Coaching staff, roster size (27), and contact info captured live from https://ballstatesports.com/sports/softball/coaches and /roster on 2026-07 (pages labeled '2027 Softball Staff/Roster'). Only three softball-specific coaching staff are listed (head coach, assistant coach, graduate assistant); the athletics site also lists shared athletic-department support staff (sports medicine, communications, strength & conditioning, academics, sports psychology) who are not softball-only coaches and are excluded from the coaches list. No coach Twitter/X handles are published on the staff page. Tuition/academic figures sourced from Wikipedia and should be reconfirmed against ballstate.edu for the current year.
